text: Trial of 48 older adults: daily walks cut blood pressure about 3 points in non-medicated people.
Coffee's memory benefit was only shown in mice, given a dose like eight cups daily.
Call-centre volunteers in China working from home gained 13 percent productivity, mostly by taking fewer breaks.
The new bridge saves northside drivers about four minutes on average, measured during school holidays.
Mixed trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds only in deficient people, one fewer cold per 30 yearly.
A four-week reading app test improved children's letter recognition but not story comprehension.
Lab tests: a pesticide at ten times field doses shortened bee foraging trips but did not kill colonies.
A volunteer-firm four-day week trial, with no comparison group, cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
